acceptance: RED actual v2-v22 mismatch rejected before create and config200 null distinguished; GREEN valid families accepted only with verified artifact/runner choice, unknown choice fails descriptive. Source+offline tests+publication; старый UNKNOWN не повторять, native create/send здесь не запускать.
